# umami_link (Resource)

A tracked short link. Visiting `<umami url>/q/<slug>` records a visit and redirects to `url`. Deleting a team deletes its links. See [documentation](https://docs.umami.is/docs/links) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "umami_config" "server" {}

resource "umami_team" "marketing" {
  name = "Marketing"
}

resource "umami_link" "launch" {
  name    = "Launch announcement"
  url     = "https://example.com/blog/launch?utm_source=newsletter"
  slug    = "launch-2026"
  team_id = umami_team.marketing.id
}

output "launch_url" {
  value = "${coalesce(data.umami_config.server.links_url, "https://analytics.example.com/q")}/${umami_link.launch.slug}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the link.
- `slug` (String) Path segment of the link URL, `<umami url>/q/<slug>` (or under `links_url`/`pixels_url` of `umami_config` when set). 8 to 100 letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, unique among the links of the Umami instance.
- `url` (String) Destination URL the link redirects to.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns the link. Owned by the authenticated user when omitted. Umami cannot move a link to another owner, so changing this replaces it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the link.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user that owns the link, when it is not owned by a team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the link ID.
terraform import umami_link.example 35c22b8a-14c0-4cf8-ac51-992a875d9918
```
